dedupe_keys.name: broj vozila s elektricnim i hibridnim pogonom

description: Broj vozila s električnim i hibridnim pogonom is a dataset listed in Open Data Portal Croatia, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Centar za vozila Hrvatske. Number of electric and hybrid powered vehicles for types M1 (personal vehicles) and L (mopeds, motorcycles and quadricycles) for the period 2007-2022. N.B.: Externally chargeable hybrid vehicles are recorded as a separate type within hybrid vehicles since 1.7.2013. Coverage: Centar za vozila Hrvatske. The portal shows the English title as "Number of vehicles with electric and hybrid propulsion" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Centar za vozila Hrvatske. The listing shows 1 download or service links in ZIP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://data.gov.hr/otvorena-dozvola). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-portal-otvorenih-podataka.
